modbus_connected.description: Whether the Modbus bus is reachable. Absent when the device reports no hardware state; a device can be online and heartbeating while its bus is unreachable.

firmware_version.description: Version of the running firmware image (`PROJECT_VER`). Sent by devices that can report it; the backend counts an update as complete only when this equals the target version and `trial` is not true.

running_slot.description: OTA slot the running image was booted from.

trial.description: True until the running image has marked itself valid after an update. Required whenever `firmware_version` is present, so a heartbeat without it can never count as an update's completion. A restart or the end of the trial window rolls the device back.

capabilities.description: Optional features the device supports, for example `firmware_update`. The backend sends `update_firmware` only to devices that list it.

last_rollback_version.description: Version of the image this device rolled back from, kept until the next update. Absent when there is none.
